newsitem.title: UK: Guinness, Grand Met down on Cazenove "sell".
newsitem.headline: Guinness, Grand Met down on Cazenove "sell".

text.p: Shares in Guinness Plc and Grand Metropolitan Plc dropped on Tuesday as Cazenove issued "sell" recommendations on both stocks, market sources said.
Guinness was down 11p, or 2.5 percent, at 437-1/2 by 1041 GMT, the biggest percent decliner in the FTSE 100 index, while Grand Met was down 4-1/2p at 445P.
In a review of the spirits sector, Cazenove issued "hold" recommendations on Allied Domecq Plc, down 6p at 434, and Highland Distilleries Plc, down 1/2p at 336-1/2, sources said.
Cazenove maintains a policy of not commenting publicly on its stock recommendations.
